item.title: Texas DPS, Potter County Sheriff's Office on scene of a wrong-way driver wreck
item.description: AMARILLO, Texas (KAMR/KCIT) — The Texas Department of Public Safety, along with the Potter County Sheriff's Office, is currently on the scene of a wreck involving a wrong-way driver in a semi-truck. item.title: Texas' most populous counties see higher numbers of early voters
item.description: In the first few days since early voting started, the most populous counties in Texas are seeing a higher turnout than the past two primaries.

item.title: DHS confirms ICE agent shot, killed driver during spring break on South Padre Island
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security has confirmed to Border Report that special agents with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement were involved in the shooting death of a man on South Padre Island in 2025 during a traffic stop last Spring Break in the South Texas border town.

item.title: State leaders outline wildfire aid, preparedness efforts in Panhandle
item.description: State leaders met in Amarillo Friday to provide an update on ongoing wildfires across the Texas Panhandle and outline resources available to ranchers and rural families as recovery efforts begin.

item.title: Court clears way for Louisiana law requiring Ten Commandments in classrooms to take effect
item.description: A U.S. appeals court has cleared the way for a Louisiana law requiring poster-sized displays of the Ten Commandments in public school classrooms to take effect. item.title: '8 Ball' Fire in Armstrong County near Highway 287 estimated 13,500 acres; 80% contained
item.description: The Friends of the Armstrong County Fire Departments issued an advisory that crews were responding to a reported grass fire near Highway 287 and County Road 29 on Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: 'Lavender' Fire in Oldham, Potter counties 18,423 acres burned; 50% contained
item.description: Fire crews are working a fire that started in Oldham County and is burning into Potter County.

item.title: Fire warning issued Tuesday after wildfire reported in Beaver County
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a fire warning at around 11:50 a.m. on Tuesday on request by the Oklahoma Forestry Service, after reports of a wildfire three miles northeast of Beaver in Beaver County.

item.title: Wildfires cause evacuations, impact traffic across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma, Kansas
item.description: During critically dry and high-wind conditions on Tuesday, multiple wildfires sparked across communities in portions of the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma and Kansas, causing a range of evacuations, warnings and road closures.
